records.text: Owens said Tiffany Barker forgot—or may not have had time—to mention in the GMA interview that her family knew Charlie Kirk and that Barker's daughter had sung at one of Kirk's events
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: but she also forgot to mention—and maybe there wasn't time to mention, to be fair—that they knew Charlie (Charlie Kirk), that the daughter had sung at Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s event.

verification.notes: The GMA video confirms Barker's interview and the episode transcript confirms Owens made this claim, attributing the family connection and singing assertion to internet sleuths. Live searches did not locate reliable primary or independent evidence that Barker's family knew Kirk or that Barker's daughter sang at one of his events. The underlying relationship and performance claims remain unverifiable.

records.text: Owens said Tiffany Barker told her that a political connection led Good Morning America to interview Barker and her nieces after contacting Phil Lyman
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And she intimated to me that actually it was a political connection. ... Her sister ran as lieutenant governor alongside Phil Lyman, and actually Good Morning America reached out to Phil Lyman, and somehow that is how—instead of her, Phil Lyman or her sister—they ended up with her sister's children and her, because they were at the event.

verification.notes: Transcript context records Owens's account of a private exchange with Barker. ABC confirms that Barker and her nieces appeared on GMA, but live research found no GMA producer communications, statement from Barker, or statement from Phil Lyman establishing the claimed referral chain. The private-conversation claim remains unverifiable.

verification.notes: Education Week reports that Education Alternatives Inc. was formed in 1986 and later bought by John Golle, which does not support wording that he incorporated it.
